scenarios.name: Grave Researcher surveils 1 at upkeep and becomes prepared with three creature cards in the graveyard
scenarios.ruling: Surveil 1 looks at the top card and may put it into the graveyard; the ability then checks the graveyard, and with three creature cards there Grave Researcher becomes prepared, which creates a copy of its prepare spell in exile.

scenarios.name: Grave Researcher surveils but does not become prepared with only two creature cards in the graveyard
scenarios.ruling: The 'Then if' clause is checked as the ability resolves, after the surveil. A Lightning Bolt binned by the surveil is not a creature card, so the graveyard still holds only two creature cards and no copy of the prepare spell is created.

scenarios.name: A creature card put into the graveyard by the surveil counts towards the three
scenarios.ruling: The ability follows its instructions in order: the surveil happens first, so a creature card it puts into your graveyard is already there when the ability checks for three or more creature cards.

scenarios.name: Reanimate puts a creature card from an opponent's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control and you lose life equal to its mana value
scenarios.ruling: The prepare spell cast from exile puts the targeted creature card onto the battlefield under the caster's control, then its controller loses life equal to that card's mana value; Grizzly Bears has mana value 2.
